check: whether S2-状态.md shares the problem found in preview-status.md - a conclusion without its reason
why: The preview-status document stated that S1C-DRAIN-01 stays open without saying why, and that reason is not obvious. S2-状态 mentions the same item three times, so it was worth asking whether this document has the same gap or is a different kind of document.

itIsADifferentKindOfDocument.selfDescription: It states plainly that the section describes the checkpoint at the time, which makes it a historical record rather than a current-status document.
itIsADifferentKindOfDocument.itReferencesForkCommits: The commit aebd485 it names does not exist in this repository - git reports it as unknown - because it is a merge commit in the RoadWeaver fork that this project interoperates with. That is consistent with the document describing the fork's state.
itIsADifferentKindOfDocument.consequence: A historical record is allowed to state its moment's conclusion without re-deriving the reason, just as the other stage reports do.

andItRemainsAccurate.claims: S2 unsigned, production OFF, the GW-011 twelve-item matrix still NOT_RUN
andItRemainsAccurate.checkedAgainst: src/main has zero commits since 50a1245, so no S2 code changed; productionWiring reads OFF across several independent evidence files; the acceptance ledger records integration-matrix as NOT_RUN

whatDiffersFromPreviewStatus: preview-status.md is the document a reader consults first for current state, which is why the missing reason mattered there. S2-状态.md is a dated checkpoint report, and adding the DRAIN-01 derivation to it would be out of place.
conclusion: No edit needed. The distinction is between documents that assert current state and documents that record a past one - the first needs its reasons, the second needs its date, and this one has it.
